newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND TO SIGN POLAR SALE ADVISER DEAL IN SEPT.
newsitem.headline: POLAND TO SIGN POLAR SALE ADVISER DEAL IN SEPT.

text.p: Poland's privatisation ministry will sign a formal agreement with its advisor in the sale of the Polar SA white goods maker by the end of the month, Privatisation Minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek said on Thursday.
In August Poland picked a consortium of Bank Handlowy w Warszawie SA and a Polish consortium firm Access to advise in the privatisation.
The state-owned Polar said earlier this week it planned to offer more than 70 million zlotys worth of new stock to the public and to enter the Warsaw bourse in the first half of 1997.

The company, which makes refrigerators, freezers and washing machines, said it would not seek a strategic investor in the near future but did not rule out an alliance with another renowned producer later.
